checks.text: The page shows the heading "Soundboard" and the text "No clips yet".

Clicking the button "Record clip" starts the recorder; after 2 seconds, clicking the button "Stop recording" adds a list item containing "Clip 1" and the text "00:02". The text "No clips yet" is gone.
After adding "Clip 1", clicking the button "Record clip" and then "Stop recording" after 3 seconds adds a list item containing "Clip 2" and the text "00:03". The list now contains two items.
Clicking the button "Play Clip 1" increments the score display to "Score: 1" and the best score display to "Best: 1".
Pressing the keyboard shortcut "1" (mapped to the first clip) increments the score display to "Score: 2" and the best score display to "Best: 2".
Clicking the button "Delete Clip 1" removes that item from the list. The list now contains only "Clip 2".
Clicking the button "Restart" resets the score display to "Score: 0" while keeping the best score display at "Best: 2".
Clicking the button "Export list" copies the text "Clip 1, Clip 2" to the clipboard.
Reload keeps the list of clips: after reloading, the list still contains "Clip 2" and the best score display shows "Best: 2".
